basis: Q2 revenue grew 21% with record bookings and net ARR growth above 40%, but the Q3 revenue guide of $281-283m is below Q2's $286.3m, a sequential decline. Gross and operating margins compressed and adjusted FCF fell to $9.8m from $46.5m. A guide that goes down quarter on quarter at a growth software name usually outweighs the bookings story. The text does not give the prior FY guide, and it carries an item 5.02 that is not described.
